title: listera cordata subsp. nephrophylla
intro: Listera cordata subsp. nephrophylla, commonly known as  Spiranthes autumnalis, is a species of orchid native to North America. This plant is traditionally used in herbal medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, that may help to alleviate symptoms associated with various health conditions. The therapeutic actions of Listera cordata subsp. nephrophylla are thought to be attributed to its ability to stimulate the immune system, as well as its antiseptic and antimicrobial properties. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids and phenolic acids, which may contribute to its medicinal effects.
